jei.soulshards.blank_soul_shard: Build the soul rune: a glowstone block with netherrack on its four sides and end stone on the next ring (two blocks out along the axes and on the four diagonals). Right-click the glowstone with a diamond: the cross turns into end stone and a soul shard appears.
jei.soulshards.soul_shard: Keep a soul shard in the hotbar while killing mobs: the first kill binds it to that mob, every kill adds souls (more with Soul Stealer). Right-click a monster spawner of the same mob to add 200 souls. Tier 1 starts at 64 souls, tier 5 at 1024.
jei.soulshards.soul_cage: Right-click with a soul shard of tier 1 or more to make the cage spawn its mob. Below tier 4 the cage only works in the mob's home dimension. A tier 5 cage spawns regardless of light and can be switched off with redstone.
